verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-agent SaaS platform, so a sandbox or test environment separate from production data is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode, test API keys, or production-data isolation. Programmatic browser sessions and continuous product-testing agents are adjacent features and do not show a non-production testing environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
